comment: M17: party members in town comment on zones and chat in pairs. 'zones' by member (or 'default'); 'pairs' unlock at minBond with each other's Bond to the player; one line every banterSteps steps at most.

default.outskirts: I don't love it out here.

kelly.downtown: If anyone from the squad sees me with you, I'm saying you're my tutor.

dex.outskirts: The old factory's got the best echo. Try it.

theo.school: I counted the lockers. There's one more than yesterday.
theo.outskirts: The woods are louder at this time of day.

mara.residential: That house had a door on the other side last week.
mara.outskirts: I want to draw the water tower. From far away.

priya.downtown: The library has a whole shelf nobody checks out. I checked.

lines: Dex: "Theo, you blinked first." Theo: "I didn't know we were playing."
Kelly: "Your drawings are creepy." Mara: "Thanks." Kelly: "...That was a compliment."
Priya: "Statistically we should be dead." Theo: "Statistically, so should everyone."
